title: [Feature] Speculative Decoding NGram NPU Implementations for MRV2
body:
### What this PR does / why we need it?
refer to: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/40704 , https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11925 
add Speculative Decoding NGram NPU Implementations for MRV2

### How was this patch tested?
test result :
|metrics|base(mrv1+ngram+async)|this pr(mrv2+ngram+async)|improve|
 | :---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
 |TTFT|63.11ms|61.81ms|-2.05%|
 |TPOT|12.22ms|8.61ms|-29.54%|

this pr script:
```
export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0
export VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1

vllm serve /nas/disk1/Qwen3-1.7B --port 8898 --dtype bfloat16 \
--tensor-parallel-size 1 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.8 \
--max-model-len 32768 --trust-remote-code \
--no-enable-prefix-caching \
--async-scheduling \
--speculative_config '{"method": "ngram_gpu", "num_speculative_tokens": 3, "prompt_lookup_max": 2,"prompt_lookup_min": 2}'
```
base script:
```
export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0

vllm serve /nas/disk1/Qwen3-1.7B --port 8898 --dtype bfloat16 \
--tensor-parallel-size 1 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.8 \
--max-model-len 32768 --trust-remote-code \
--no-enable-prefix-caching \
--async-scheduling \
--speculative_config '{"method": "ngram_gpu", "num_speculative_tokens": 3, "prompt_lookup_max": 2,"prompt_lookup_min": 2}'
```
test script:
```
export CONCURRENCY=10

vllm bench serve \
  --port 8898 \
  --backend vllm \
  --model /nas/disk1/Qwen3-1.7B \
  --endpoint /v1/completions \
  --dataset-name sonnet \
  --dataset-path /model/xk/vllm/benchmarks/sonnet.txt \
  --max-concurrency ${CONCURRENCY} \
  --sonnet-input-len 128 \
  --sonnet-output-len 100 \
  --sonnet-prefix-len 10 \
  --num-prompts 100 \
  --ignore-eos \
  --percentile-metrics "ttft,tpot,itl,e2el" \
```


- vLLM main: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/c0b6f74bee518aeaf5d72b200a0216e72fbb5e7c
